cards.extra: *These injuries are best treated surgically with dorsal plating of the ulna and reduction with fixation or arthroplasty of the radial head. The major complications seen with this injury pattern are nonunion and plate failure. Almost all patients have some loss of elbow range of motion. Satisfactory results based on functional scores for this injury are not universal. Neurologic injury and ulnohumeral instability are unusual with this type of injury. Full functional recovery is not expected with nonsurgical management.
